commits.subject: roadmap(ajc): collapse 41 spent housekeeping nodes so the mathematics is legible again
commits.summary:
**The legibility problem, inverted.** The AJC tree carried 70 `AJC.maintenance.*` nodes six levels deep against 56 mathematical ones, so `roadmap list --focus AJC.jacobian` rendered engineering chores at four levels of detail and ~59k lines of finished algebraic geometry as almost nothing. It is now **29 maintenance against 58 mathematical, max depth 3**.

**What was retired and why.** The 25-node `warnings.residual.*` subtree became obsolete when the last 102 mechanical warnings were cleared; that node is now one `done` item carrying the whole 1,174 → 24 arc. The Čech contractibility and resource-budget leaves recorded per-declaration benchmarks that survive in the ledger and in their parents summaries. Nothing open was lost: `explicit-carriers` stays because a deliberately ruled-out route is worth keeping, and the three genuine Čech base-change obligations were already covered by `AJC.fbc`.
